defmodule PdfVault.Generator do
  @moduledoc "PDF generation with encrypted storage"

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @encryption_algo :aes_256_gcm
  @iv_length 12
  @tag_length 16
  @pending_dir "/tmp/pdf_vault/pending"
  @vault_dir "/var/lib/pdf_vault/encrypted"

  defstruct [:master_key, :pending_jobs, :completed_jobs]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    master_key = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :master_key)
    File.mkdir_p!(@pending_dir)
    File.mkdir_p!(@vault_dir)
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{master_key: master_key, pending_jobs: %{}, completed_jobs: %{}}}
  end

  @doc "Submit a PDF generation job. Returns job_id for retrieval."
  def submit_job(template, params, requester_id) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:submit, template, params, requester_id})
  end

  @doc "Retrieve encrypted PDF by job_id"
  def retrieve_pdf(job_id, requester_id) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:retrieve, job_id, requester_id})
  end

  @doc "Check job status"
  def job_status(job_id, requester_id) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:status, job_id, requester_id})
  end

  def handle_call({:submit, template, params, requester_id}, _from, state) do
    job_id = generate_job_id(template, params, requester_id)
    job_meta = %{
      id: job_id,
      requester_id: requester_id,
      template: template,
      params: params,
      status: :pending,
      submitted_at: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    }

    # Write manifest to pending directory for async processing
    manifest_path = Path.join(@pending_dir, "#{job_id}.manifest")
    File.write!(manifest_path, :erlang.term_to_binary(job_meta))

    new_state = %{state | pending_jobs: Map.put(state.pending_jobs, job_id, job_meta)}
    
    # Spawn async PDF generation
    spawn_link(fn -> generate_and_encrypt(job_id, template, params, requester_id, state.master_key) end)

    {:reply, {:ok, job_id}, new_state}
  end

  def handle_call({:retrieve, job_id, requester_id}, _from, state) do
    case Map.get(state.completed_jobs, job_id) do
      nil ->
        {:reply, {:error, :not_found}, state}
      job_meta ->
        if authorized?(job_meta, requester_id) do
          encrypted_path = Path.join(@vault_dir, "#{job_id}.enc")
          case File.read(encrypted_path) do
            {:ok, data} -> {:reply, {:ok, data}, state}
            {:error, reason} -> {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
          end
        else
          {:reply, {:error, :unauthorized}, state}
        end
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:status, job_id, requester_id}, _from, state) do
    cond do
      Map.has_key?(state.completed_jobs, job_id) ->
        job_meta = Map.get(state.completed_jobs, job_id)
        if authorized?(job_meta, requester_id), do: {:reply, :completed, state}, else: {:reply, {:error, :unauthorized}, state}
      Map.has_key?(state.pending_jobs, job_id) ->
        job_meta = Map.get(state.pending_jobs, job_id)
        if authorized?(job_meta, requester_id), do: {:reply, :pending, state}, else: {:reply, {:error, :unauthorized}, state}
      true -> {:reply, :unknown, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_cast({:job_completed, job_id, job_meta}, state) do
    new_state = %{state |
      pending_jobs: Map.delete(state.pending_jobs, job_id),
      completed_jobs: Map.put(state.completed_jobs, job_id, job_meta)
    }
    {:noreply, new_state}
  end

  # Job ID includes requester_id - prevents cross-user deduplication
  defp generate_job_id(template, params, requester_id) do
    content = :erlang.term_to_binary({template, params, requester_id})
    :crypto.hash(:sha256, content) |> Base.hex_encode32(case: :lower) |> binary_part(0, 24)
  end

  defp generate_and_encrypt(job_id, template, params, requester_id, master_key) do
    # Simulate PDF generation
    pdf_content = render_pdf(template, params)
    
    # Derive per-document key from master key and job_id
    doc_key = derive_document_key(master_key, job_id)
    
    # Encrypt the PDF
    iv = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(@iv_length)
    {ciphertext, tag} = :crypto.crypto_one_time_aead(
      @encryption_algo, doc_key, iv, pdf_content, job_id, @tag_length, true
    )
    
    encrypted_blob = iv <> tag <> ciphertext
    
    # Write to pending first, then move to vault
    pending_path = Path.join(@pending_dir, "#{job_id}.enc.tmp")
    vault_path = Path.join(@vault_dir, "#{job_id}.enc")
    
    File.write!(pending_path, encrypted_blob)
    # Atomic move to vault
    File.rename!(pending_path, vault_path)
    
    # Clean up manifest
    manifest_path = Path.join(@pending_dir, "#{job_id}.manifest")
    File.rm(manifest_path)
    
    # Notify completion with requester_id preserved
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:job_completed, job_id, %{requester_id: requester_id, completed_at: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)}})
  end

  defp derive_document_key(master_key, job_id) do
    # Use HMAC-SHA256 as a proper keyed KDF instead of plain hash concatenation
    :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, master_key, job_id)
  end

  defp render_pdf(template, params) do
    # Simplified PDF rendering
    header = "%PDF-1.4\n"
    body = "Template: #{template}\nParams: #{inspect(params)}\n"
    header <> body <> "%%EOF"
  end

  defp authorized?(job_meta, requester_id) do
    # Authorization check: requester must match original submitter
    job_meta.requester_id == requester_id
  end
end

defmodule PdfVault.Retrieval do
  @moduledoc "Public API for PDF retrieval with access control"

  @vault_dir "/var/lib/pdf_vault/encrypted"

  def get_document(job_id, requester_id) do
    # Always go through the GenServer for access control
    case PdfVault.Generator.job_status(job_id, requester_id) do
      :completed ->
        PdfVault.Generator.retrieve_pdf(job_id, requester_id)
      :pending ->
        {:error, :still_processing}
      :unknown ->
        {:error, :not_found}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end
end
